headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: SAI (7)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Italian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 6.1s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Valtteri Bottas made the biggest climb, from P14 to P10.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P7 to P12.
The stewards penalised RUS (5 second time penalty), HAM (5 second time penalty) and SAR (5 second time penalty).
There were 25 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 145 points over Sergio Perez.
